payload.summary: Planned standardizing host port allocation on the coordinator's PortAllocatorService, fixed for persistence, session ownership, conflict reporting, reconciliation, and an isolation gate, with a shared PortLease client in skills/shared that falls back to a same-arithmetic file registry and emits one env contract every consumer reads. Tier: coordinated (coordinator at coord.rotkohl.ai reachable with all capabilities). Gate 1 direction was taken from the preceding conversation, where the user chose to standardize on the coordinator allocator; Gate 2 is pending.

decisions.title: Coordinator is the lease ledger; the client is the host's eyes
decisions.rationale: The coordinator runs in a container with no host socket or compose visibility; bind probes and reconciliation must run client-side and be reported. Keeps the tunnel-exposed surface unchanged.

decisions.title: Persist leases in Postgres, in-memory remains standalone mode
decisions.rationale: A coordinator restart must not forget leases while compose stacks still hold the ports. Write-through to a port_leases table shaped like file_locks; standalone mode unchanged.

decisions.title: Leases belong to agent sessions
decisions.rationale: cleanup_dead_agents releases leases and reports ports_released; heartbeat refreshes; TTL is only a backstop. One staleness definition, not two clocks.

decisions.title: Isolation gate is client-reported and downgrade-only
decisions.rationale: The coordinator does not know a session's environment; the client sends isolation_provided from EnvironmentProfile.detect(). Once true it cannot be lowered. Worktree is not isolation for ports.

decisions.title: Five-port block with ui_port at offset +4
decisions.rationale: Lets the kanban dev server origin be leased and derived into CORS instead of hardcoded 5173.

decisions.title: File backend keeps the coordinator's slot arithmetic
decisions.rationale: Both backends compute identical blocks from PORT_ALLOC_* so a host flipping between them cannot overlap; the 15432-25432 range is retired.

decisions.title: SKILL.md edits confined to env-default lines
decisions.rationale: extract-gen-eval-package and factory-missions-architecture-alignment are in-flight writers of validate-feature phase 4b; restructuring that block would create a three-way conflict.

next_steps: wp-contracts first; wp-coordinator, wp-skills-client, wp-consumers run in parallel against the contract

relevant_files.description: proposal with three approaches, Approach 1 selected
